title: Migrate leads to a BC
content_data:
Use this endpoint to migrate leads from an ad account to a Business Center. During the migration, a form library will be created to hold the leads from the ad account. ## Comparing v1.2 and v1.3 The following table outlines the differences between v1.2 and v1.3 endpoints. ```xtable |Changes{30%}|v1.2{35%}|v1.3{35%}| |---|---|---| |Endpoint path| /v1.2/pages/library/transfer/| /v1.3/page/library/transfer/| |Request parameter data type|`advertiser_id`: number
`bc_id`: number |`advertiser_id`: string
`bc_id`: string | |Response parameter data type|`library_id`: number |`library_id`: string | ``` ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/page/library/transfer/ **Method** POST **Header** ``` xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |Access-Token{Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1738373164380162).| |Content-Type {Required}|string|The content type of the request.
Allowed value: `"application/json"` | ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |advertiser_id {Required} | string| ID of the advertiser that owns the leads. | |bc_id {Required} | string | ID of the Business Center that you want to migrate leads to. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl -H "Access-Token:xxx" -H "Content-Type:application/json" -X POST \ -d '{ "advertiser_id": "ADVERTISER_ID", "bc_id": "BC_ID" }' \ https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/page/library/transfer/ (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field|Data Type|Description| |---|---|---| |code |number | Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |message |string | Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |data |object| Returned data. | #|library_id|string|ID of the form library that was created to hold the leads for the ad account.| |request_id|string|The log id of the request, which uniquely identifies a request. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "message": "OK", "code": 0, "data": {} } (/code) ```
